knowledge_id.description: Numeric public knowledge ID returned by `GET /v3/knowledges`.
knowledge_id.title: Knowledge Id

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor`. Pass it back unchanged to fetch the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. v3 list endpoints accept 1-100.
limit.title: Limit

sort_order.description: Sort direction. Allowed values are `asc` and `desc`.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

document_type.description: document 타입 필터 (복수 반복 가능). 예: `?document_type=file&document_type=text`.
document_type.title: Document Type

status.description: Status filter. Repeat the query parameter to filter by multiple statuses when the endpoint supports multiple values.
status.title: Status
